calls.title: Kari / Guy SDK connections
calls.summary: The redesign of the SDK connections page aims to enhance key configuration visibility and streamline user management. Improved visibility of edited fields was introduced by Guy Langford-lee to allow users to track changes without needing to open modals. Webhooks have been separated into their own tab to clarify workflows and reduce confusion, while advanced settings in the creation and editing flows are now collapsed by default to emphasize essential options. The approval process for revisions will trigger upon second draft creation, aligning with existing protocols for features and saved groups. The anticipated release is within four weeks, highlighting the team's collaborative efforts in finalizing the design and functionality.
calls.keywords: SDK connections, revisions, webhooks, UI redesign, remote evaluation, setup instructions
